definitions.contracts_traded: Kalshi `volume_fp` — contracts exchanged on the market. Source: GET /markets.
definitions.open_interest_contracts: Kalshi `open_interest_fp` — contracts currently held. Source: GET /markets.
definitions.traded_notional_dollars_derived: volume_fp x price_used, where price_used is last_price_dollars if present else the mid of yes bid/ask. Derived, not returned by Kalshi.
definitions.open_interest_dollars_derived: open_interest_fp x price_used (same price basis). Derived.
definitions.resting_liquidity_dollars: sum over orderbook levels of price x contracts, for both YES and NO bids. Computed from GET /markets/{ticker}/orderbook.
definitions.implied_asks: Kalshi returns bids only; a YES bid at X is a NO ask at 1-X, so asks are derived. Source: https://docs.kalshi.com/getting_started/orderbook_responses.md

resolutions.formula: Count of settled markets per topic by Kalshi `result` (yes/no/scalar/blank). Input: data/resolutions.json (GET /markets?status=settled).

settlement_lag_hours.formula: (settlement_ts - close_time) in hours, for rows where both timestamps exist.
settlement_lag_hours.note: Negative values mean the market settled before its scheduled close, which the API permits via early close (can_close_early).

liquidity_snapshot.formula: Per tracked market: total resting dollars and derived YES spread from the orderbook.

data_quality.note: Blank cells in the site mean the API did not return that field, or the data requires an API key this repo does not have.

portfolio.reason: GET /portfolio/* requires the signed headers KALSHI-ACCESS-KEY, KALSHI-ACCESS-TIMESTAMP and KALSHI-ACCESS-SIGNATURE (Ed25519 or RSA-PSS). No demo API key is configured for this repository, so no balance, position, fill or P&L figure is published. Observed 401 responses are recorded in the Auth status panel.
portfolio.to_enable: Add repository secrets KALSHI_DEMO_KEY_ID and KALSHI_DEMO_PRIVATE_KEY (Settings > Secrets and variables > Actions). The workflow portfolio.yml then writes data/portfolio.json and the Portfolio page lights up with real numbers.

trade_execution.reason: POST /portfolio/orders is a signed, authenticated write. Without a key the dashboard cannot place demo orders, and it must not fabricate fills.
trade_execution.to_enable: Same secrets as above, plus ALLOW_LIVE_DEMO_TRADING=true on the workflow so a human consciously enables write access.

websocket.reason: The WebSocket API requires the same signed handshake even for public market-data channels, so it cannot be opened from an unauthenticated static page. The site therefore polls committed REST snapshots (hourly, plus manual dispatch).
websocket.to_enable: Add the same demo key secrets; collector/ws_stream.py can then keep a signed socket open and append tick-by-tick observations to data/history/. Until then the chart uses REST candlesticks and the hourly snapshot log, both of which are real API data.
